Name: Pinned Mine Elevator
Author: LavandaEzh
Description:
When farming ore or monster eradication goals in the Mines [b]or Skull Cavern[/b], constantly aiming at the same floor button in the elevator menu gets old fast. With Pinned Mine Elevator, you don't have to aim at all.
[b]How it works[/b]
[list]
[*][b]Only in the Mines & Skull Cavern:[/b] A vanilla-styled hanging tag appears right under your Quest Log only while you're at the Mine entrance, underground, or in the Skull Cavern (with Skull Cavern Elevator installed), keeping your screen clean elsewhere.[/*]
[*][b]Click to Pin:[/b] Click the unlocked tag and pick your target floor from the elevator menu.[/*]
[*][b]Instant Travel:[/b] Interact with the elevator to immediately jump to your pinned floor—no menu, no extra clicks.[/*]
[*][b]Click to Unpin:[/b] Click the locked tag again at any time to clear the pin and use the elevator normally.[/*]
[/list][b]Details[/b]
[list]
[*]Remembers your pinned floors [b]separately for the Mines and Skull Cavern[/b] per save file.[/*]
[*][b]Full compatibility with Skull Cavern Elevator:[/b] Respects your custom elevator step and floor cost settings.[/*]
[*]Matches the vanilla UI style, fading smoothly during transitions and dimming under open menus.[/*]
[*]Includes English and Russian translations.[/*]
[/list]

Manifest.Name: Pinned Mine Elevator
Manifest.Description: Adds a lock button under the journal to pin a specific mine elevator floor.
